governing_equation: d2w_dx2 = (gel_youngs_modulus / gel_thickness) * half_span**2 / (crust_shear_modulus * crust_thickness) * w - half_span**2 / (crust_shear_modulus * crust_thickness) * load_pressure * exp(-pi * (x * half_span / load_width)**2)

parameters.name: half_span
parameters.justification: Half-width of the modelled strip from the load centre (symmetry at x=0) to a far edge at ~3 spreading lengths, where deflection has decayed; kept small so the 0.3 mm load is resolved.
